final: WITH operator_rates AS (SELECT crewref, AVG(1.0 * gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY crewref), all_operator_rate AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS rate FROM operator_rates), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM operator_rates WHERE avg_gb_per_min > (SELECT rate FROM all_operator_rate)) SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scans_per_operator, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) - (SELECT rate FROM all_operator_rate) AS excess_gb_per_min FROM above_average
